agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, August 02, 2016 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Sanchez
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
a.
Recognition of the Lomita Park Martial Arts Program for their participation and placement at the Soo Bahk Do Moo Duk Kwan National Championships.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
City of Lomita
City Council Agenda
TUESDAY, AUGUST 2, 2016 AT 6:30 PM
Lomita City Hall - Council Chambers
24300 Narbonne Avenue. . Lomita, CA 90717
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Special Meetings held on June 7, 2016 and July 19, 2016 and the Regular Meeting of July 19, 2016
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Resolution 2016-38 Approving the Demands and Payroll.
ACTION: That said resolution be adopted approving the demands and payroll.
Item #7c
d.
Consider approval of a Public Works contract with Ferguson Enterprises, Inc. for installation of Advanced Metering Infrastructure Water Meters
ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council:
1)
Authorize a sole-source contract with Ferguson Enterprises, Inc. in the amount of $87,733.33 for installation of Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) Water Meters, and
2)
Approve a total budget of $96,506, which includes a contingency for unforeseen conditions and/or extra work; and
3)
Authorize the City Manager to sign the contract. City of Lomita
City Council Agenda
TUESDAY, AUGUST 2, 2016 AT 6:30 PM
Lomita City Hall - Council Chambers
24300 Narbonne Avenue. . Lomita, CA 90717
Item #7d
e.
Amendment No. 2 to Professional Services Agreement with Hazen and Sawyer Engineers and Scientists for the Cypress Water Production Facility Upgrades Project.
ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council:
1)
Authorize the City Manager to execute Amendment No. 2 to the Professional Services Agreement with Hazen and Sawyer Engineers and Scientists for the Cypress Water Production Facility and Zone 2 Connection Projects, in the amount of $51,803; and
2)
Approve a revised total budget amount of $203,467 (which includes a 10% contingency for unforeseen scope/conditions; and
3)
Direct staff to hold another public Water Subcommittee meeting after the completion of Amendment No. 2 Tasks Nos. 1 and 2.
Item #7e
f.
Consideration of letters to the Federal Aviation Administration, Congresswoman Maxine Waters, Congresswoman Janice Hahn, and Congressman Ted Lieu regarding new offshore helicopter routes
ACTION: To direct the Mayor to sign the attached letters to the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), Congresswoman Maxine Waters, Congresswoman Janice Hahn, and Congressman Ted Lieu opposing the new voluntary offshore helicopter routes.
Item #7f
g.
Approval of Final Map for Parcel Map No. 72623
ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council find and approve as follows:
1)
That the subdivision has met and performed all applicable requirements and conditions imposed pursuant to State Subdivision Map Act (Government Code Section 66410, et. Seq.) and the City's subdivision ordinances; and
2)
That the proposed subdivision is in substantial compliance with the previously approved tentative map; and
3)
That division and development of the property, in manner set forth on the approved tentative map for this subdivision, will not unreasonably interfere with the free and complete exercise of any right of way or easements owned by any public entity and/or public utility in accordance with Section 66455 of the State Subdivision Map Act; and
4)
Approve the final map for Parcel Map No. 72623; and
5)
Instruct the City Clerk to endorse on the face of Parcel Map No. 72623 the certificate that embodies the approval. City of Lomita
City Council Agenda
TUESDAY, AUGUST 2, 2016 AT 6:30 PM
Lomita City Hall - Council Chambers
24300 Narbonne Avenue. . Lomita, CA 90717
Item #7g
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
8.
APPOINTMENT OF VOTING DELEGATE FOR THE LEAGUE OF CALIFORNIA ANNUAL CONFERENCE TO BE HELD IN LONG BEACH FROM OCTOBER 5-7, 2016 ACTION: That the City Council approve appointing _____________, as the voting delegate and ____________ as the alternate for the City of Lomita for the League of California Cities Annual Conference business meeting to be held on Friday, October 7, 2016 at 12 noon.
Item #8
9.
CONSIDERATION AND DISCUSSION REGARDING A STATE OF THE CITY LUNCHEON FOR NOVEMBER 17, 2016
Presented by Parks Director Harding
ACTION: That the City Council direct staff to plan and organize a State of the City Luncheon on November 17, 2016 in the Community Room at the Tom Rico Center at Lomita Park.
Item #9
10.
ADJOURNMENT In Memory of Candice Bergan, Lomita Resident and former Parks and Recreation Commissioner
The next regular meeting of the Lomita City Council will be held on Tuesday, August 16, 2016 at 6:30 p.m.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
